checks.name: Publish signed macOS arm64 Core sidecar

comments.body: **Historical fixture fallback retained** The new reader falls back to historical fixtures that stored diagnostic labels in `tool_use_id`, despite current producers already emitting `native_slo_attempt`. This violates the repository directive that legacy fallbacks and tests must not be supported. Require `native_slo_attempt` and update the remaining historical fixtures and fallback test rather than maintaining both representations. This repository requirement must be satisfied before merging. **Rule Used:** What: "Legacy" should not be supported Why: We want to eliminate tech debt Good: No legacy fallbacks, redirects, tests, etc. ([source](https://app.greptile.com/hol/-/custom-context?memory=c1ba7189-733a-40b9-8b0d-2e7a5f85a373))

**Prohibited nested conditional** The new installed Ollama probe selects the publisher-error label with `error if error in _PUBLISHER_ERRORS else "unclassified" if error else "none"`. This violates the repository directive prohibiting nested ternaries and requiring clear conditionals. Compute the label with explicit `if`/`elif`/`else` branches before constructing the diagnostic mapping. This repository requirement must be satisfied before merging. **Rule Used:** Nested ternies are illegal. All logic should be clear and use conditionals. ([source](https://app.greptile.com/hol/-/custom-context?memory=5bc5a84f-7863-4cc9-9d5a-575de0b9b6be)) Note: If this suggestion doesn't match your team's coding style, reply to this and let me know. I'll remember it for next time!
